title: Near-Unit-Root Theory for Affine Processes
summary: Discrete-time affine processes are widely used in finance and economics and encompass count, positive, and nonnegative-valued processes. This paper develops near-unit-root asymptotic theory for this class of models. Unlike linear AR(1) processes, affine processes exhibit time-varying conditional variance that remains asymptotically non-negligible near unity, leading to qualitatively different scaling limits and estimator behavior.
